_note: Sample copy for this reference repo. In production, every template is written and approved by a clinical reviewer; the model only ever picks an ID.

HT-001.text: This sounds urgent. I'm alerting emergency help and your caregiver now. Stay where you are if it is safe.

HT-010.text: I'm letting your caregiver know you'd like to go out, so someone can be with you.

HT-011.text: I'm not sure I understood. I'm asking your caregiver to check in with you.

HT-014.text: Changes to your medicine are best decided by your prescriber. I'm sending them your question.

HT-020.text: I couldn't show that safely. A person will follow up with you.
